owner_creation.analysis: IO_WAITING (src/runtime.rs:1-110): The AtomicUsize owns the number of active IoWait guards, initialized at zero; each IoWait::new increments once.
owner_creation.invariant: Each live guard contributes one wait count.
limitations: Review covers this atomic storage and its wait/interrupt protocol only; M0-SIG-004 remains open for rless_signal sentinel conversions.

aliases_escapes.analysis: IO_WAITING (src/runtime.rs:1-110): os::intio reads a copied count to decide whether to post an interrupt; it receives no reference to a guard or buffer.
aliases_escapes.invariant: The count does not expose guard storage.
limitations: Review covers this atomic storage and its wait/interrupt protocol only; M0-SIG-004 remains open for rless_signal sentinel conversions.

callback_targets.analysis: IO_WAITING (src/runtime.rs:1-110): IoWait::drop is static Rust destructor dispatch; the numeric counter stores no dynamically selected destructor or native callback.
